Found.Title: Null-safe Count for updateTurn collection fields under StrictMode
Found.Body: New-McpPluginTurnUpsertRequest and Invoke-WorkflowUpdateTurn enumerate tags and contextList with @() or equivalent under Set-StrictMode Latest. Covered by FR-MCP-STRICTCOUNT-001 TEST-MCP-STRICTCOUNT-001.

AcceptanceCriteria.text: updateTurn collection fields use null-safe enumeration under StrictMode

Found.Title: Failsafe drain abort markers include backend_unavailable and HTTP 503
Found.Body: Test-ReplFailsafeBackendUnreachable matches backend_unavailable and HTTP 503. Invoke-ReplFailsafeDrainOnFirstSuccess does not set completed before a 503 pass and does not increment drainAttempts or quarantine on that abort. Covered by FR-MCP-FAILSAFE-001 TEST-MCP-FAILSAFE-001.

AcceptanceCriteria.text: Failsafe drain abort markers include backend_unavailable and HTTP 503 and do not burn drainAttempts

Found.Title: SessionEnd cache flush no-ops when cache cannot be resolved
Found.Body: Invoke-CacheFlushHook and cache-manager do not throw on unresolved cache. CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is a Resolve-McpCacheDir fallback. Covered by FR-MCP-SESSIONEND-001 TEST-MCP-SESSIONEND-001.

AcceptanceCriteria.text: SessionEnd cache flush no-ops when cache cannot be resolved

Found.Title: Assert-ReplCurrentTurnFresh refuses different sourceType prefixes
Found.Body: Assert-ReplCurrentTurnFresh compares sessionId sourceType prefix. Different prefix refuses CompleteTurn persist. Same prefix still rebinds. persist identity keeps planFile/todoId. Covered by FR-MCP-XAGENT-001 TEST-MCP-XAGENT-001.

Found.Title: code-verify catch disk-full and enforce wrapper timeout
Found.Body: code-verify.ps1 catches IOException for disk full as a typed status and applies a hard timeout around the wrapper so the console is released. Covered by FR-MCP-VERIFYWRAP-001 TEST-MCP-VERIFYWRAP-001.

AcceptanceCriteria.text: code-verify catches disk-full and enforces wrapper timeout

Found.Title: Sticky root session cache rebind and degraded persist
Found.Body: plugins/core cache-scope keeps root session-state for UserPromptSubmit. ReplacePluginCache retains or rebinds. Resolve-McpCacheDir uses hook workspace path when env and profile cwd would fail. Get-ReplMethodTimeoutSeconds long list includes workflow.agenthelp.submitTurn. beginTurn degraded path and completeTurn persist identity are implemented in repl-invoke.ps1.
